sources.title: CPython 3.9.6 clock implementation
sources.paraphrase: The Apple monotonic implementation subtracts a process-local static reference; the non-Windows performance-counter implementation delegates to this clock.

sources.title: Python time.monotonic documentation
sources.paraphrase: The documentation records a macOS change in Python 3.10 making the clock the same for all processes.

scope: Reference-source support for the explanation; not attestation that the running Apple Python binary is byte-identical to upstream CPython. Actual saved frame and owner observer clocks independently show the failed common-origin assumption. Per-process clock differences remain usable. No historical result reclassification.
